prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 多列数值 · 8 列 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 8 columns × 5 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Per-column content facts (content px at 13px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "日期" · longest unbreakable word 38px · one-line width 77px
  col 2: header "开盘" · longest unbreakable word 34px · one-line width 34px
  col 3: header "最高" · longest unbreakable word 34px · one-line width 34px
  col 4: header "最低" · longest unbreakable word 34px · one-line width 34px
  col 5: header "收盘" · longest unbreakable word 34px · one-line width 34px
  col 6: header "涨跌幅" · longest unbreakable word 48px · one-line width 48px
  col 7: header "成交量（手）" · longest unbreakable word 61px · one-line width 80px
  col 8: header "成交额（万元）" · longest unbreakable word 69px · one-line width 93px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 607px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 606px.
Fixed: content, font, 13px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

The image shows the table's content with every cell on one line, so you can read everything. Study it first.
1) Understand it: what is the table for, how will people read, scan and compare it, which columns play the same or similar role, which values must stay intact, which text may wrap naturally, and where existing row height could absorb wrapping.
2) Propose 3 genuinely different column-width designs for 607px (different strategies, not small variations).
Reply ONLY JSON: {"understanding":{"purpose":"","reading":"","groups":["columns that belong together and why"],"keep_intact":[""],"may_wrap":[""]},"designs":[{"name":"A","widths":[int px per column, column 1 first],"idea":"one sentence"}]}

log.raw: {"understanding":{"purpose":"按日期展示股票的价格、涨跌幅和成交情况，便于比较各交易日的行情。","reading":"读者可横向查看同一日的行情，纵向比较各日价格、涨跌幅和成交规模；每行应清楚地读作一个整体。","groups":["开盘、最高、最低、收盘都是价格，宜保持相同列宽，方便逐列比较。","成交量（手）与成交额（万元）都描述交易规模，位于表格右侧，数值较长。","涨跌幅衔接价格与成交数据，其正负号和百分号具有重要含义。"],"keep_intact":["日期及其分隔符","价格数值","带正负号和百分号的涨跌幅","带千位分隔符的成交量和成交额"],"may_wrap":["成交量（手）和成交额（万元）的表头可在文字与单位之间换行；数据行仍可保持单行。"]},"designs":[{"name":"A","widths":[98,55,55,55,55,69,101,114],"idea":"所有表头和数据均保持单行，四个价格列等宽，整体占用602px。"},{"name":"B","widths":[110,62,62,62,62,76,82,90],"idea":"给日期、价格和涨跌幅更多呼吸空间，让两个成交指标的表头换行，占满606px。"},{"name":"C","widths":[98,55,55,55,55,69,82,90],"idea":"采用紧凑布局并让两个成交指标的表头换行，保持数值完整，右侧留下47px空白。"}]}
